A group of educators, scienQsts, hunters, community representaQves, and decision makers deliver this contaminants communicaQon and research training program to prepare students for their future role as criQcal frontline contaminant workers and communicators. • This workshop, a collaboraQon between the NCP and Nunavut ArcQc College, is a unique plaborm for students to interact with NCP researchers and acQvely parQcipate in contaminants research through skill-‐building and interacQve lab acQviQes and group discussions.
• The workshop has grown in scale and scope over the last nine years.
